name: emphasis
description: Replies you can scan: [[Pills]] and known labels gain a glyph in the terminal, and the model is told how to write them. Display-only.

display.title: Draw pills
display.description: Replace [[Word]] pills and known labels with glyphs in the reply on screen. The stored message, ctrl+o, copied text and the model's view keep the original Markdown.

guidance.title: Teach the model
guidance.description: Add a reply-style section to the system prompt telling the model which pills and labels to write. Off: you write the rules yourself.
